examples.purpose: A plan card with its own earnings rows, perks and an upgrade button.
examples.jsx:
<BenefitCard
  headerTitle="You will earn"
  headerItems={[
    { icon: 'ic_jewellery_diamond', title: 'JioPoints', trailingText: 'Up to 2000 pts' },
    { icon: 'ic_offer', title: 'Cashback', trailingText: 'Up to ₹5000' },
  ]}
  items={[
    { icon: 'ic_card', title: 'Zero forex markup on cards' },
    { icon: 'ic_support', title: 'Priority support, 24/7' },
  ]}
  buttonLabel="Upgrade"
  onButtonPress={() => {}}
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}
/>

from.quote: “JioPoints” with “Up to 2000 pts”, two perks, and “Upgrade”.

examples.purpose: Full width on a plan screen, without the upsell, in one brand.
examples.jsx:
<BenefitCard
  width="100%"
  bodyHeader={null}
  headerItems={[{ icon: 'ic_offer', title: 'Cashback', trailingText: 'Up to ₹5000' }]}
  items={[{ icon: 'ic_support', title: 'Priority support, 24/7' }]}
  onButtonPress={() => {}}
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', AppearanceBrand: 'Tertiary' }}
/>

from.quote: bodyHeader set to null closes the gap between the lists.

props.name: headerTitle
props.description: Header section title (e.g. `"You will earn"`). Default "You will earn", from the component source.

props.name: headerItem
props.description: Deprecated: The header is now a multi-row list wrap. A single item still works and is rendered as a one-row list (lowest precedence, after `header` and `headerItems`). Prefer `headerItems` (declarative) or `header` (slot).

props.name: headerItems
props.description: Defaults to two duplicate JioPoints rows, a placeholder. Declared: Declarative header list-wrap rows shown under the header title and above the divider (icon + title + optional trailing value). Replaces the legacy single {@link BenefitCardProps.headerItem}. Ignored when the `header` slot is provided.

props.name: header
props.description: Real slot for the header "list wrap" (the rows under the header title). Highest precedence — when provided, these children render instead of `headerItems` / `headerItem`; `modes` (plus the `List Item Style: Minimal` style) cascade into every child automatically.

props.name: showHeader
props.description: Toggles the whole header section (title + item + divider). Mirrors the Figma `showHeader` property. Defaults to `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: bodyTitle
props.description: Deprecated: In the Figma redesign the plain body title was replaced by a slot-based upsell `Nudge` ({@link BenefitCardProps.bodyHeader}). Still honored for backward compatibility: when set, it renders as a plain text title in place of the default nudge. Prefer `bodyHeader`.

props.name: bodyHeader
props.description: Defaults to the upsell Nudge; null or false removes it; a node replaces it. Declared: Real slot rendered between the header divider and the body list — in the Figma reference this is an upsell `Nudge` (avatar + highlighted "JioFinance+" message). Defaults to that nudge. Pass `null`/`false` to hide it, `bodyTitle` for the legacy plain-text title, or any `ReactNode` for full control; `modes` cascade into the slot.

props.name: items
props.description: Defaults to two placeholder rows; children wins over items. Declared: Body benefit rows. Ignored when `children` is provided (the slot wins).

props.name: children
props.description: Real slot for the body "list wrap". When provided, these children render instead of `items`; `modes` (plus the `List Item Style: Minimal` style) cascade into every child automatically.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: CTA button label. Defaults to `"Upgrade"`. Default "Upgrade", from the component source.

props.name: onButtonPress
props.description: CTA press handler.

props.name: button
props.description: Replaces the call to action; null still renders the default button, so hide it with showButton false. Declared: Full override for the CTA. Takes precedence over `buttonLabel`.

props.name: showButton
props.description: Toggles the CTA button. Mirrors the Figma `showButton` property. Defaults to `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Since a116616 the header becomes a Pressable button named by accessibilityLabel, else headerTitle, else bodyTitle; the lists become a pointer-only press region with no role or Tab stop, and each dims to 0.92 opacity while pressed. With showHeader false the lists are the button. The upsell and the card's button are siblings, not children. Declared: Press handler for the card body. The upgrade button and the upsell stay siblings of this control, so they are not nested inside it.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width. Defaults to the Figma spec (`344`). Pass `'100%'` to fill the parent. Default 344, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Cascades to the card's children, each over its own defaults: rows (List Item Style Minimal, Nudge padding None), icons (AppearanceBrand Secondary), figures (Text Sizes Small, Weight Regular), the button (Button / Size S) and the upsell (AppearanceBrand Neutral). A consumer AppearanceBrand overrides all three brand defaults at once. Declared: Modes object for design-token resolution. Cascaded to all children.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the card container.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the card.

props.name: BenefitCardItem.icon
props.description: Registry icon name for the leading glyph (e.g. `'ic_jewellery_diamond'`). A field of each headerItems and items row.

props.name: BenefitCardItem.iconColor
props.description: Per-item override for the leading icon color. Defaults to the brand token. A field of each headerItems and items row.

props.name: BenefitCardItem.leading
props.description: Full override for the leading node. Takes precedence over `icon`. A field of each headerItems and items row.

props.name: BenefitCardItem.title
props.description: Row title (e.g. `"JioPoints"`). A field of each headerItems and items row.

props.name: BenefitCardItem.trailingText
props.description: Optional right-aligned trailing value (e.g. `"Up to 2000 pts"`). A field of each headerItems and items row.

props.name: BenefitCardItem.trailing
props.description: Full override for the trailing node. Takes precedence over `trailingText`. A field of each headerItems and items row.

props.name: BenefitCardItem.onPress
props.description: Makes the row pressable. A field of each headerItems and items row.

slots.name: headerItems
slots.description: A structured slot: an array of BenefitCardItem rows. Declarative header list-wrap rows shown under the header title and above the divider (icon + title + optional trailing value). Replaces the legacy single {@link BenefitCardProps.headerItem}. Ignored when the `header` slot is provided.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Real slot for the header "list wrap" (the rows under the header title). Highest precedence — when provided, these children render instead of `headerItems` / `headerItem`; `modes` (plus the `List Item Style: Minimal` style) cascade into every child automatically.

slots.name: bodyHeader
slots.description: Real slot rendered between the header divider and the body list — in the Figma reference this is an upsell `Nudge` (avatar + highlighted "JioFinance+" message). Defaults to that nudge. Pass `null`/`false` to hide it, `bodyTitle` for the legacy plain-text title, or any `ReactNode` for full control; `modes` cascade into the slot.

slots.name: items
slots.description: A structured slot: an array of BenefitCardItem rows. Body benefit rows. Ignored when `children` is provided (the slot wins).

slots.name: children
slots.description: Real slot for the body "list wrap". When provided, these children render instead of `items`; `modes` (plus the `List Item Style: Minimal` style) cascade into every child automatically.

slots.name: button
slots.description: Full override for the CTA. Takes precedence over `buttonLabel`.
